label: OPEN activity clause alone: at the selected world, whatever causes something is concrete
paraphrase: OPEN activity clause alone (the weaker half of STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS): at the selected world, whatever causes something is concrete. It does not infer capacity from exercise and does not define concreteness; under the adopted esse sense it says every cause at w has esse in re.
